title: IGEV-Stereo
description: An iterative stereo network by Gangwei Xu et al. (geometry encoding volume with ConvGRU updates), with several fine-tuned checkpoints.
html:

Details
  • Original code: https://github.com/gangweix/IGEV at 4a3d937aab78
  • Code licence: MIT (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: MIT (assumed from code)
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/gangweix/IGEV/blob/4a3d937aab788b3ff3ed49b7b5c81340ab46a5eb/README.md#L17
  • Training data: Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa)
    • igev-stereo-middlebury: Middlebury submission model
    • igev-stereo-eth3d: ETH3D submission model
    • igev-stereo-kitti12: Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa), KITTI stereo 2012 / 2015 (SceneFlow, then fine-tuned on KITTI (KITTI 2012 submission model))
    • igev-stereo-kitti15: Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa), KITTI stereo 2012 / 2015 (SceneFlow, then fine-tuned on KITTI (KITTI 2015 submission model))
  • Options: iters = 32 (>= 1)
  • Kernel libraries: igev, cutlass_conv, cudnn_hacc
  • Variants: igev-stereo-sceneflow, igev-stereo-middlebury, igev-stereo-eth3d, igev-stereo-kitti12, igev-stereo-kitti15
  • Outputs: disparity
  • Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): igev-stereo-sceneflow 3000x4000 (10.3 GiB peak allocated, 14.0 reserved); igev-stereo-middlebury 3000x4000 (10.3 GiB peak allocated, 14.0 reserved); igev-stereo-eth3d 3000x4000 (10.3 GiB peak allocated, 14.0 reserved); igev-stereo-kitti12 3000x4000 (10.3 GiB peak allocated, 14.0 reserved); igev-stereo-kitti15 3000x4000 (10.3 GiB peak allocated, 14.0 reserved)
  • igev-stereo-middlebury, igev-stereo-eth3d, igev-stereo-kitti12, igev-stereo-kitti15: same network and settings as igev-stereo-sceneflow, measured once (rows not repeated).
  • igev-stereo-sceneflow original (fp32) 994x1482, original 994x1482: timed with igev-stereo-eth3d (same network, other weights)
  • igev-stereo-sceneflow portable 994x1482, kernels 994x1482: measured on igev-stereo-eth3d (same architecture, other checkpoint)
  • igev-stereo-sceneflow load / first call: original 0.32 s / 2.565 s (375x1242), portable 0.47 s / 0.763† s, kernels 0.15† s / 0.286† s
  • igev-stereo-middlebury load / first call: original 0.32 s / 2.565 s (375x1242), portable 0.47 s / 0.763† s, kernels 0.15† s / 0.286† s
  • igev-stereo-eth3d load / first call: original 0.32 s / 2.565 s (375x1242), portable 0.47 s / 0.763† s, kernels 0.15† s / 0.286† s
  • igev-stereo-kitti12 load / first call: original 0.32 s / 2.565 s (375x1242), portable 0.47 s / 0.763† s, kernels 0.15† s / 0.286† s
  • igev-stereo-kitti15 load / first call: original 0.32 s / 2.565 s (375x1242), portable 0.47 s / 0.763† s, kernels 0.15† s / 0.286† s
  • † measured in the speed sweep after the portable load (or an earlier size) in the same process: file cache and kernels are warm, so the time is lower than a fresh start.
  • Protocol, median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input (synthetic for bench_inputs sizes), card defaults; gc before each load; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls
